repositories.name: Airlines-Delay-Prediction
repositories.description: This project aimed to develop a machine learning model to predict the likelihood of a flight being delayed, using only a provided "Airlines" dataset. The secondary objective was to analyze airline-related features to identify the most significant factors contributing to these delays.
